name: stca
description: Screen polymer repeat units with STCA, extract readable rules from measured data, connect thermal and electrical objectives, and verify rule-guided candidates.

interface.longDescription: Use Sliding Threshold Correlation Analysis (STCA) for polymer repeat units. Apply frozen structural rules to candidate libraries; extract readable rule families from measured data; connect independently scaled Tg, Tm, Td, TC, EC and ε-AC objectives; and export executable constraints for agent-assisted candidate design followed by explicit structural verification. The skill keeps the original star-containing repeat-unit SMILES for final results, uses H-cap only as a calculation representation, accepts arbitrary identifier-column names, and calls the pinned polymer-stca implementation. It requires a Python/RDKit execution environment.
defaultPrompt: Screen this polymer candidate table for high Tg, low EC and high TC. Choose the tier for each objective independently, then report the same-candidate intersection and failed rule conditions.
Extract and freeze STCA rules from this measured Td dataset, then evaluate the independent holdout and export the readable rule family.
Export structural constraints for low ε-AC and high thermal stability, propose candidates, and verify every proposal against the frozen rules.
